latest_release.name: v2.1.0
latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* Upgrade to protocol3 by @crossoverJie in https://github.com/crossoverJie/cim/pull/163
* Protocol add properties by @crossoverJie in https://github.com/crossoverJie/cim/pull/164
* [fix] Cross-platform compilation by @chenqwwq in https://github.com/crossoverJie/cim/pull/165
* feat: Support allin1 docker image by @crossoverJie in https://github.com/crossoverJie/cim/pull/169
* feat: Enhance messaging system with batch message support by @crossoverJie in https://github.com/crossoverJie/cim/pull/171
* Feat/offline msg by @Zdanquxunhuan in https://github.com/crossoverJie/cim/pull/170
* build(deps): bump com.mysql:mysql-connector-j from 8.0.33 to 8.2.0 in /cim-persistence/cim-persistence-mysql by @dependabot in https://github.com/crossoverJie/cim/pull/173

## New Contributors
* @chenqwwq made their first contribution in https://github.com/crossoverJie/cim/pull/165
* @Zdanquxunhuan made their first contribution in https://github.com/crossoverJie/cim/pull/170

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/crossoverJie/cim/compare/v2.0.0...v2.1.0
